nodes.description: InvestorsStorage instance holding the iterable investor map (balances, payment times, refs, ref bonuses) for the current wave.
Mapping address => referrer address, records the one-time referral link of an investor.
Public address that receives the admin commission (5%) on every investment.
Cumulative ETH invested in the current wave; incremented without SafeMath in doInvest.
Percent struct (355/10000 = 3.55%) used to compute per-period investor dividends.
Percent struct (5/100 = 5%) used to compute the admin commission.
Percent struct (3/100) for the second-level? no, first-level referral bonus.
Percent struct (2/100) for the second-level referral bonus.
Percent struct (1/100) bonus for the advertiser that onboarded a new investor.
Counter of investment transactions in the current wave.
Timestamp when the current wave was started (set from block.timestamp in nextWave).
Flag that is set/reset around wave restarts in nextWave.
Owner of InvestorsStorage, used by onlyOwner guarded mutators.
Public payable investment entry point: validates msg.value, pays referral/ad bonuses, pays dividends, forwards admin commission and writes investor state.
Public accessor (balanceChanged) that lets an investor claim accrued dividends via _getMyDividents(false).
Private core payout logic: computes elapsed days from block.timestamp, updates payment time and forwards ETH via sendDividends / sendDividendsWithRefBonus.
Private payout helper using low-level addr.send(value).
Private payout helper using low-level addr.send(value+refBonus).
Private wave reset: deploys a new InvestorsStorage, zeroes counters and stores block.timestamp in waveStartup.
Contract constructor: sets adminAddr = msg.sender and calls nextWave().
Payable fallback: with msg.value == 0 claims dividends, otherwise decodes the referrer from msg.data and calls doInvest.
ERC20AdToken.transfer: records msg.sender as advertiser for the recipient (no real token movement).
ERC20AdToken.massAdvertiseTransfer: loops over addresses and records msg.sender as advertiser.
InvestorsStorage.insert (onlyOwner): adds a new investor to the iterable map.
InvestorsStorage.addRefBonus (onlyOwner): credits a referral bonus to an investor.
InvestorsStorage.addRefBonusWithRefs (onlyOwner): credits a referral bonus and increments the refs counter.
InvestorsStorage.addValue (onlyOwner): increases an existing investor's stored value.
InvestorsStorage.setPaymentTime (onlyOwner): writes the last payment timestamp of an investor.
InvestorsStorage.setRefBonus (onlyOwner): overwrites the accrued referral bonus of an investor.
Internal helper returning true when addr is non-zero and different from msg.sender.
InvestorsStorage.updateStats: accumulates per-day invested amounts and investor counts.
Caller-controlled address used as investor, referrer, advertiser and owner-check subject.
Block timestamp (now) used for dividend day counting, payment time and date accounting.
Low-level external call addr.send(value) / addr.send(value+refBonus) that transfers dividends to the investor.
External call adminAddr.transfer(...) forwarding the admin commission after dividend payment.
Unchecked multiplication m_dividendsPercent.mul(investor.value) * daysAfter can overflow / misprice payouts.
Assembly extraction of a referrer address from raw msg.data (ToAddress.toAddr) inside the fallback path.
Referrer address parameter of doInvest.
Recipient address parameter of sendDividends.
Dividend value parameter of sendDividends.
Referral bonus parameter of sendDividendsWithRefBonus.
Local variable value in doInvest holding the investment amount plus referral bonus.
Local variable daysAfter in _getMyDividents: elapsed dividend periods since the last payment.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the investing investor address inside doInvest.
msg.sender selects the investor whose dividends are computed in _getMyDividents.
transfer() records msg.sender in adtransfers as the advertiser.
massAdvertiseTransfer records msg.sender in adtransfers for every address.
onlyOwner of InvestorsStorage.insert compares msg.sender with owner.
onlyOwner of addRefBonus compares msg.sender with owner.
block.timestamp (now) determines the dividend payout days in _getMyDividents.
doInvest uses now for payment time, referral events and date string accounting.
now is emitted in the LogPayDividends event from sendDividends.
nextWave stores block.timestamp into waveStartup.
m_dividendsPercent.mul(investor.value) feeds the unchecked multiplication with daysAfter.
m_dividendsPercent adds the referral bonus over the investment amount in doInvest.
m_adminPercent.mul(msg.value) is the value forwarded by adminAddr.transfer.
m_refPercent1 computes the first-level referral bonus in doInvest.
m_refPercent2 computes the second-level referral bonus in doInvest.
m_adBonus computes the advertiser bonus in doInvest.
m_investors is read and mutated (insert/addValue/setPaymentTime) throughout doInvest.
m_investors provides investor info and setPaymentTime/setRefBonus in _getMyDividents.
nextWave creates a fresh InvestorsStorage and assigns it to m_investors.
m_referrals is read and written to establish the one-time referral link.
totalInvested is incremented with msg.value at the end of doInvest.
totalInvestments counter is incremented at the end of doInvest.
owner is the trusted value checked by the onlyOwner modifier of insert.
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender in InvestorsStorage.
ref parameter is the referrer candidate validated in doInvest.
Referrer address decoded from msg.data by assembly flows into doInvest.
Dividend value computed in _getMyDividents is exposed to the unchecked multiplication overflow.
The (possibly overflowing) dividend value is passed into sendDividends.
notZeroNotSender gates the referrer/advertiser bonus branches in doInvest.
notZeroNotSender compares the candidate address against msg.sender.
ref parameter is validated through notZeroNotSender.
addr parameter of sendDividends is the recipient of the low-level send call.
value parameter of sendDividends is the ETH amount forwarded by addr.send.
refBonus parameter of sendDividendsWithRefBonus is added to the ETH amount sent.
Local value computed in doInvest is written to storage through addValue.
Local daysAfter multiplies the dividend percentage producing the payout amount.
doInvest calls _getMyDividents(true) before paying the admin commission and updating storage.
doInvest performs adminAddr.transfer(m_adminPercent.mul(msg.value)).
doInvest inserts the sender into InvestorStorage for a first investment.
doInvest calls addRefBonus for level-2, best investor and advertiser bonuses.
doInvest calls addRefBonusWithRefs for the first-level referrer.
doInvest calls addValue when the sender already exists.
doInvest calls setPaymentTime(msg.sender, now).
doInvest updates per-day statistics through updateStats.
getMyDividends invokes _getMyDividents(false).
_getMyDividents pays plain dividends through sendDividends.
_getMyDividents pays dividends plus referral bonus through sendDividendsWithRefBonus.
sendDividends performs an external ETH transfer to the investor address.
sendDividendsWithRefBonus performs an external ETH transfer to the investor address.
The constructor calls nextWave() to initialise the first wave.
The fallback routes non-zero msg.value to doInvest.
The fallback with msg.value == 0 routes to getMyDividends.
The fallback decodes the referrer address from raw msg.data using assembly.
The ETH send to an investor can re-enter the payable fallback before payout state is final.
The external transfer to adminAddr occurs before investor storage is updated, allowing re-entry into doInvest.

normalization_plan.reason: The referrer parameter is only used inside doInvest and should be normalised into that function node.
The recipient parameter is only meaningful as the send target of sendDividends.
The amount parameter is only meaningful as the send amount of sendDividends.
The ref bonus parameter belongs to the sendDividendsWithRefBonus payout path.
Local value is the investment amount computed and stored inside doInvest.
Local daysAfter is the timestamp-derived period counter used only in _getMyDividents.
